response.sql: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_of_avg_anas FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_acl_igg, s.avg_ana, s.avg_ana / o.mean_of_avg_anas as ana_ratio FROM sex_averages s CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
